title: Copilot reflection and telemetry - pilot
description: Derived assessments and filtered native telemetry. Project attribution and usage accounting remain unverified; raw spans are not usage totals.

options.content:
### Continuous metadata pilot
VS Code Insiders is configured to send metadata from **all projects** after a window reload, with content and identity capture disabled. The local collector filters traces before persistence/upload and discards logs and aggregate metrics. Project attribution and the native accounting layer are **not verified**: incoming spans remain `unattributed` and must not be summed as usage totals.

Archived-conversation analysis is approved only for `personal/copilot-otel`, once daily at **09:00 local time**, for new sessions with no backfill. The capture/analysis worker is **not installed yet**. This is separate from continuous telemetry. The time picker filters assessment creation time and span start time; this text is not a live health signal.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
CopilotAssessments_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| where Origin != 'synthetic_azure_model_smoke'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Origin, ProjectId, SessionId, Revision
| summarize arg_max(Revision, *) by Origin, ProjectId, SessionId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| project TimeGenerated, ProjectId, Outcome, Summary, Origin, Limitations, SessionEndedAt
| order by TimeGenerated desc

CopilotAssessments_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| where Origin != 'synthetic_azure_model_smoke'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Origin, ProjectId, SessionId, Revision
| summarize arg_max(Revision, *) by Origin, ProjectId, SessionId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| summarize LastAssessment=max(TimeGenerated), EligibleRowsVisible=count() by ProjectId, Origin
| extend MinutesSinceAssessment=datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastAssessment)
| order by LastAssessment desc

panels.title: Usage and reliability - not collecting verified totals

options.content:
The background collector runs continuously. Reload VS Code Insiders to activate its global metadata export; no prompts, replies, code, tool payloads, or identity fields are permitted in dashboard storage.

The table below shows individual incoming spans, not validated usage totals. Invocation and model-call spans may overlap, so their token counts must not be summed. Project labels remain `unattributed` until native workspace identity is verified; selecting a named project cannot recover missing labels.

Last trace time indicates data freshness, not current process health. Daily conversation analysis remains a separate, not-yet-installed worker.

panels.title: Incoming telemetry - raw spans, not usage totals

azureLogAnalytics.query:
OTelSpans
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where tostring(Attributes['telemetry.origin']) == 'unverified_client'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TraceId, SpanId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend ProjectId=tostring(Attributes['project.id'])
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| project TimeGenerated, ProjectId, Operation=tostring(Attributes['gen_ai.operation.name']), Model=tostring(Attributes['gen_ai.response.model']), InputTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), OutputTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']), CacheReadTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens']), DurationMs, TraceId, SpanId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
